thesis: Specific action and dependable follow-through are his response to fear and comparison.
summary: Fifteen tough-love lessons move from the spotlight effect and criticism to following energy, testing advice, creating opportunity through volume and follow-through, competing against one’s prior self, defining concrete actions and asking after earning help. He urges quick hard conversations, persistence, outcome ownership and rejection tolerance, then frames some career changes as reversible.
